initialPose.initialization: preserved construction pose; world translation applied 0; initial velocity zero

interpretation.contactLaw: Support row stabilization=0.2 and slop=0.002 m. The native contact kernel sets targetGap=(1-stabilization)*min(initialSeparation,0), recovering 20% of an initial overlap per root step. Thus a roughly 0.1 mm starting overlap creates a short first-step impulse; rows 2+ in native rollback-010 have zero normal impulse.
interpretation.poseAndPlane: NHCNT ground normal is +Z and the world frame is x-forward/y-left/z-up. The current native first-step contact gap agrees with the independent source support witness within about 5.3 micrometers; this does not indicate a bed-direction or registration-frame mismatch.
interpretation.rootSpeed: The 0.436 m/s progress field is the floating-root origin generalized linear speed (the source prints acceptedV[0:3]), not a direct whole-body COM speed. At accepted step 1, the logged COM is 0.957 m from the root origin, and the root orientation also changes; a substantial root-origin velocity can therefore coexist with a much smaller total COM translation. Do not interpret the root-origin speed as a whole-body translational launch speed or as evidence of a bed-direction error.
interpretation.transfer: Rigid placement check validated 2332 coarse vertices with maximum point residual 1.74 micrometers. The separate FEM transfer reports 3.66 mm RMS and 42.6 mm maximum projection; this affects mapping fidelity but is not the source of this stand-contact impulse.

nativeFirstStep.contactOwner: existing_metal_stand / full registered source skin partition
nativeFirstStep.femSkinSelfContact: deferred material-column binding; not this support force owner

proposedPhysicalInitializationCorrection.calculation: deltaZ = targetClearance - measuredSeedGap; candidateZ = float32(oldZ + deltaZ). This is a common rigid re-placement and creates no force.
proposedPhysicalInitializationCorrection.operation: Apply one common rigid translation along the bed normal before release, then retain zero initial velocity and the existing contact solver.
proposedPhysicalInitializationCorrection.status: Candidate only; not applied or native-replayed. Recheck all 32 current-pose support witnesses after selecting root-versus-bed ownership.

scope: Read-only audit receipt with a proposed initialization correction; no native inputs, sources, or forces were changed.

witness.kind: NHCNT source support skin vertex at exact source-pose FK and invocation root transform
witness.measurementBasis: Independent source-geometry FK replay of the retained NHRIGID/NHCNT/skin payloads using this exact root pose and q overrides; this is a construction-pose witness, not a full-body penetration certificate.
